title: Applying Finch Circle Tier Benefits to Returns, Price Adjustments, Delivery, Alterations and Registry
content:
A Finch Circle Loyalty Program member's service benefits — free return shipping, extra return days, extra price-adjustment days, the restocking fee waiver, the home delivery discount, the rush alteration fee waiver and the registry completion bonus — are read from the tier held on the date of the occurrence they apply to:

| Benefit | Tier read on |
|---|---|
| Extra return days and free return shipping | the return date |
| Extra price-adjustment days | the price-adjustment request date |
| Home delivery discount | the delivery booking date |
| Rush alteration fee waiver | the alteration ticket date |
| Registry completion bonus | the registry completion purchase date |
| Restocking fee waiver | the date of the occurrence it applies to |

A suspended or closed membership gives no benefit, and a customer who is not a member is treated as having none. Benefits attach to the member's own transactions only and are not lent to a guest, a registry giver or another household member.

A tier upgrade (a tier change recorded as an upgrade) also posts the new tier's tier upgrade bonus points once, as a tier bonus entry on the points history; a downgrade or a card floor posts no bonus.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A member moves up to Finch Circle Diamond on 10 May and returns an item on 12 May: the return is read at Finch Circle Diamond, the tier held on the return date.
- A member whose membership is suspended on the delivery booking date receives no home delivery discount.
- A guest buying from a Finch Circle Icon member's registry does not receive the member's benefits.
- A card floor that lifts a membership to Finch Circle Gold posts no tier bonus points; an upgrade into Finch Circle Gold posts that tier's bonus once.
